dependencies.title: W15-A: lazy bounded native evidence loader contract for inspector details (loaded on focus; unavailable is visible, never fabricated); dialog/host wiring excluded
dependencies.description:
Today src/ui/workflow-inspector.ts details view prints "Evidence / details · producer references, not fetched payload" and lists raw evidenceRefs strings; nothing can be loaded. Add the lazy, bounded native evidence loader CONTRACT and its inspector integration without touching any hot file. Real provider loaders (Forge gate status, Furnace run, Claude transcript) and dialog/host wiring are the parent W15/Sr. Engineer's work.

Deliver:
1. src/workbench/evidence-loader.ts (new):
   - `interface EvidenceLoader { readonly provider: string; canLoad(ref: string): boolean; load(ref: string, context: { scope: ObservationScope; signal: AbortSignal; maxBytes: number }): Promise<EvidenceContent> }`.
   - `type EvidenceEntry = {state:'not-requested'} | {state:'loading'} | {state:'loaded'; provider: string; capturedAt: string; bytes: number; truncated: boolean; preview: readonly string[]} | {state:'unavailable'; reason:'no-loader'|'unauthorized'|'transport'|'timeout'|'too-large'}`.
   - `class EvidenceStore` constructed with `{ loaders: readonly EvidenceLoader[]; maxEntries: number; maxBytes: number; timeoutMs: number }`: `get(scope, ref): EvidenceEntry`, `request(scope, ref): Promise<void>` (idempotent while loading), `abort(scope, ref)`, LRU eviction keyed by JSON.stringify([workspace, principal, ref]); previews are produced by passing loader text through `redactWorkbenchText` (import from src/workbench/redaction.ts — do not edit) then `safeWorkflowTerminalText` (import from src/ui/workflow-card.ts — do not edit), split into bounded lines; raw payloads are never retained. A ref whose scope does not match the store entry's scope is `unavailable: unauthorized` without consulting any loader.
2. src/ui/workflow-inspector.ts: `InspectorModel.evidence?: Pick<EvidenceStore,'get'>` (optional read side); `InspectorState.evidenceIndex: number`; in the details view `e` advances the evidence selection (wrapping) and `enter` returns `{ state, action: 'load-evidence' }` for the selected ref (new InspectorAction member — src/ui/workflow-dialog.ts' existing else-if chain ignores it, so the dialog is NOT edited in this bead); layoutInspector renders per-ref state as `not loaded (Enter)`, `loading…`, `unavailable: <reason>`, or the bounded preview lines, and never renders preview text for a ref whose entry is not `loaded`. When `model.evidence` is absent, today's rendering is unchanged (all existing inspector tests stay green).
3. Tests: test/workbench-evidence-loader.test.ts (new) and appended cases in test/workbench-inspector.test.ts (keep every existing case verbatim).
dependencies.acceptance_criteria:
All criteria quote docs/workbench specs in the rig (branch workbench/implementation-program).
1. docs/workbench/10-terminal-inspector.md § "Four views" (Details): "Large content loaded only on focus." -> with a counting fixture loader installed, a full keyboard journey over overview/graph/timeline plus the first details render records zero load calls; exactly one call follows `enter` on the selected ref; `e` moves evidenceIndex without loading.
2. docs/workbench/10-terminal-inspector.md § "Four-view viewport increment": "Missing edges, timestamps and evidence loaders are visible unknowns, never fabricated." -> a ref with no matching loader renders `unavailable: no-loader`; a throwing loader renders `unavailable: transport`; a loader exceeding timeoutMs renders `unavailable: timeout`; none renders preview text, and the status/tone lines are unchanged.
3. docs/workbench/09-observation-and-provenance.md § "Data retention and privacy": "Avoid raw prompts/tool bodies by default; store reference/short redacted preview ... UI fetches full text lazily subject to permission." -> store holds at most maxEntries entries (LRU eviction proven) and at most maxBytes per entry (1 MiB payload -> `truncated: true`, bytes reported, preview bounded); a payload containing `Bearer abc123` and `"api_key":"xyz"` renders with `[REDACTED]`.
4. docs/workbench/09-observation-and-provenance.md § "Acceptance/negative controls" item 10: "Large/secret payload does not leak into Pi tool result or screen by default." and docs/workbench/12-security.md § "Input and output hardening": "Validate Unicode and terminal escape sequences before display (no untrusted ANSI injection)." -> a preview containing `\x1b[31m`, U+202E and U+200B renders sanitized at 80x24 and 120x40 in ASCII and Unicode tiers (visibleWidth never exceeds width); a cross-scope ref (different workspace or principal) is `unavailable: unauthorized` and the loader is never invoked.
5. docs/workbench/10-terminal-inspector.md § "Failure and deception defenses": "Node result with missing evidence is not marked verified merely because process exited 0." -> the existing test 'status success and missing evidence does not become Verified' stays green and a `loaded` entry never alters status text or tone glyph.
6. docs/workbench/10-terminal-inspector.md § "Navigation": "Closing view never stops workflow." -> Esc/ctrl+c during `loading` yields action 'close' only; the store's abort() aborts the loader AbortSignal and no projection method or provider is called (spy proof).
7. docs/workbench/10-terminal-inspector.md § "Rendering pipeline": "Pure layout and keyboard reducers are unit-tested without a TTY." -> every new test runs without a TTY; layoutInspector remains synchronous and never awaits a loader.
Process: red-first (new tests fail before the module/reducer exist); ./node_modules/.bin/biome check --write on touched files; no `any`; no inline imports; never weaken or delete existing tests; do not edit src/ui/workflow-card.ts, src/workbench/redaction.ts, src/index.ts or src/ui/workflow-dialog.ts; forge run lint / typing / test green in the worktree.
